text: {"final": {"summary": "Created scripts/resend_failed_sms.py (P1): it loads the SMS outbox and gateway delivery statuses, selects only lines whose SMS id is recorded as 'failed', deduplicates per household (first failed message's details win), and appends one new outbox line per household with a fresh SMS id (next_number/format_sms_id) while copying the original household_id, phone, template_id, params and text verbatim, with queued_at from config.settings.now(). It never calls queue_sms and never modifies existing lines. Ran it once (P2): 10 households whose texts failed each got exactly one new message (SMS-00022..SMS-00031); delivered messages were left untouched.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2"]}}
